newsitem.title: USA: Sears, Roebuck completes Mexico sale.
newsitem.headline: Sears, Roebuck completes Mexico sale.

text.p: Sears Roebuck and Co and Grupo Carso SA de CV said Wednesday they have completed the sale by Sears of 60 percent of the outstanding shares in Sears, Roebuck de Mexico SA de CV to Grupo Carso for $103 million, or $2.2889 per share.
Sears retains a 15 percent interest in Sears Mexico, the companies said.
After receiving the appropriate government approvals, Grupo Carso has said it will tender for the remaining shares not owned by Sears at the equivalent price paid to Sears.
Sears Mexico retains the right to use the Sears name in Mexico, under an exclusive license with a five-year initial term, the companies said.
